source.label: stellar/stellar-core release v29.0.0
source.text:
## What's Changed
* Improve DEX offer crossing accuracy. by @dmkozh
* P29 bump by @sisuresh
* Don't count pool hops against limit by @sisuresh
* Bump env to internal v29 by @sisuresh
* Remove hash-of-hash optimization. by @dmkozh
* Drop over-limit messages early by @bboston7
* Outbound queue load shed fix by @marta-lokhova
* Don't read messages during auth handshake by @SirTyson
* Lower max message size in protocol 29 by @bboston7
* Point release/v29.0.0-internal to public rs-soroban-env by @anupsdf 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/stellar/stellar-core/compare/v28.0.1...v29.0.0

whatHappened.text: The release notes document updates for Stellar-core version 29.0.0, including protocol-level changes.
Several technical improvements were made, such as optimizing DEX offer crossing and adjusting message size limits.
Specific fixes related to network capacity and message handling were implemented, including outbound queue load shedding.
